Who We Are
NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and movement becomes momentum. As a global platform revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers, and potential to turn into performance. With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

Your Role in Our Mission
You'll be joining our core engineering team to build a flagship mobile application from the ground up. As a Android Developer, you'll play a foundational role in shaping the Android experience through a fully native Jetpack Compose presentation layer, powered by Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) for shared business, networking, and data logic. You'll bring strong Android engineering fundamentals, a product-minded approach, and a passion for clean architecture to build high-quality applications that deliver seamless experiences across different Android devices.

How You’ll Make an Impact
Build & Innovate
•
Develop and maintain high-quality native Android applications using modern Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
•
Contribute to building a flagship mobile application from the ground up, helping shape its architecture and technical direction.
•
Build flexible, responsive layouts that adapt seamlessly across phones, foldables, and tablets.
Cross-Platform Development & Integration
•
Integrate and contribute to shared Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) modules for business logic, networking, and data management.
•
Work with third-party APIs, libraries, and services to deliver robust application functionality.
•
Collaborate with iOS/Swift engineers to ensure consistency and alignment across mobile platforms.
Performance & Engineering Excellence
•
Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and well-documented code, following principles such as KISS and Separation of Concerns.
•
Optimize Jetpack Compose performance by managing recompositions, implementing efficient Lazy lists, and improving application launch times.
•
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve performance and application stability issues.
•
Maintain high engineering standards through rigorous code reviews, constructive feedback, and quality-focused pull requests.
Product Collaboration
•
Partner with product managers and UX/UI designers to translate product requirements and designs into intuitive mobile experiences.
•
Participate in Agile development practices, contributing to planning, execution, and continuous improvement.
•
Stay curious about emerging technologies and contribute to the evolution of our mobile engineering practices.

What You Bring
•
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
•
4+ years of professional Android development experience, with a proven track record of shipping and maintaining production applications.
•
Strong practical knowledge of Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, and Material Design 3 guidelines.
•
Experience with modern Android architecture patterns such as MVVM or MVI, with the ability to separate UI state from core business logic using Coroutines and Flows.
•
Experience consuming RESTful APIs and WebSockets, and working with asynchronous data flows using tools such as Ktor or Retrofit.
•
Hands-on experience building modern Android App Widgets using Glance or traditional RemoteViews.
•
Proficiency with Git and modern dependency management practices, including Gradle Kotlin DSL and Version Catalogs.
•
Strong coding skills, moderate algorithmic problem-solving ability, and a commitment to clean code principles and maintainable architecture.
•
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, participate in code reviews, and communicate technical decisions clearly.
•
A growth mindset and willingness to explore and learn parts of the Apple ecosystem when required.

Your X-Factor
•
Hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP/KMM) or previous experience developing native iOS applications.
•
Experience building custom graphics and charts using Compose Canvas, including K-line charts, curves, and pie/bar charts.
•
Familiarity with AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, with the engineering rigor to test, audit, and take ownership of AI-generated code.
•
A product-first mindset and the ability to build intuitive, performant, and user-focused mobile experiences.

Your Journey after Applying
•
30 minute HR interview with the Talent Acquisition team member
•
Assessment stage
•
45 minute Problem Solving Interview
•
60-minute Bar Raiser Interview

Why Join NEXT
At NEXT Ventures, we believe the right talent fuels breakthrough innovation. If you're driven to connect great minds with big ideas and want to shape the future of fintech, we’d love to meet you. Join our team of bold thinkers where technology meets transformation.
Apply now and be part of our journey — the future is calling, and it starts with you.

About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Risk Engineering

The Role: Senior Associate, Fraud Operations

As a Senior Fraud Operations Associate in the Fraud domain, you will work to enhance and expand the features of our fraud detection and mitigation systems across various product lines, including Exchange, Credit Card, Equities, Predictions, Wallet, and across the entire customer lifecycle. You will be responsible for investigating customer accounts for first, second, and third party fraud, including payment instrument abuse, scams, and account takeovers. You will also be instrumental in shaping Gemini’s fraud models and rules, working regularly with product, engineering, and data science, as well as improving and optimizing operations itself to ensure a balance between customer friction and fraud.

Responsibilities:

• Investigate financial fraud and scams across multiple product lines

• Review complex data sets, such as ACH/debit card/credit card/wallet transactions, device telemetry, and blockchain data

• Respond to customers to obtain additional information regarding the actions that occurred on their account to make a properly informed decision

• Identify trends and patterns in fraud activity and suggest rule, feature, and policy updates

• Deeply understand the customer journeys to identify pain points due to fraud controls and suggest updates to alleviate them

• Leverage experience and knowledge to suggest improvements to operational flows

• Prepare fraud reports on material investigations and general fraudulent activity and present to leadership at weekly meetings

• This role may require an on-call or extended hours during fraud events

Minimum Qualifications:

• BA/BS in finance, economics, accounting, or related fields, or equivalent experience in said field

• 3-5+ years of direct fraud investigative experience, including in ACH and credit card fraud

• 2-5+ years of direct scam and account integrity investigative experience

• Knowledge of device telemetry data, account integrity systems, and internet technologies, such as VPNs

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Comfortable with making decisions in high ambiguity environments

• A healthy balance of empathy and skepticism, and the ability to acknowledge incorrect decisions

Preferred Qualifications:

• Regional fraud knowledge, including in the US and Singapore

• Experience with IDV, KYC, and transaction monitoring systems

It Pays to Work Here

The compensation & benefits package for this role includes:

• Competitive starting pay

• A discretionary annual bonus

• Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant

• Comprehensive health plans

• 401K with company matching

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible time off

Hourly Range: The hourly range for this role is between $43.50 - $58.00 in the State of New York. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. Employees who do not live near one of our hubs are part of our remote workforce. All employees, however, are required to onboard in-person at one of our office locations.

At Gemini, we strive to build diverse teams that reflect the people we want to empower through our products, and we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Equal Opportunity is the Law, and Gemini is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a specific need that requires accommodation, please let a member of the People Team know.

About the role
IC Markets is hiring a Senior Database Administrator to own the reliability, performance, and security of the PostgreSQL estate behind our trading platform. You will be the person we trust to keep this platform fast, safe, and audit-ready as transaction volumes grow.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure operations seat. You will tune real workloads, review schema and query design with application teams, and set the standards that keep our data layer healthy under intermittent heavy load.

Key responsibilities
Performance & capacity
• Own connection management strategy end to end — introduce and operate connection pooling (RDS Proxy or PgBouncer).
• Establish query-level observability: enable and maintain pg_stat_statements, define baselines, and drive down the slowest and most frequent queries.
• Tune memory and planner parameters (work_mem, shared_buffers, effective_cache_size and related settings) against the actual instance profile and workload.
• Review indexing strategy: identify redundant, duplicate, and unused indexes; recommend and validate new ones against production access patterns.
• Plan capacity and scaling ahead of demand, including read-replica and Aurora scaling decisions.

Reliability & operations
• Own backup, restore, and point-in-time-recovery strategy, and prove it with regular restore tests.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp Senior Manager, Payment Partnerships to join GTXN - a Luno company and own the sourcing, negotiation and delivery of new banking and payment-provider partnerships across Africa and Southeast Asia. You will bring hands-on experience building payment-provider and banking relationships in African markets, and be comfortable owning a deal from first conversation through contracting and go-live. Experience doing the same in Southeast Asia is a strong advantage.

Your mission will be:

• Identify, prioritise and build a pipeline of payment providers, banks and PSPs across African markets (and select Southeast Asian markets) that can extend GTXN’s ability to move money for Luno’s customers.

• Negotiate commercial terms — pricing, settlement, liability, SLAs — that improve the cost, coverage and reliability of GTXN’s payment rails.

• Work closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk and Product/Engineering to ensure new partnerships meet regulatory, licensing and integration requirements before go-live.

• Monitor partner performance against agreed SLAs (uptime, settlement times, success rates) and drive remediation where partners underperform.

• Track regulatory, competitive and market developments across target emerging markets that could affect partner selection or deal terms.

• Represent GTXN with key partners and at industry events, building GTXN’s reputation as a partner of choice in target markets.

• Feed market intelligence into GTXN’s regional expansion strategy, helping prioritise markets and partners with the strongest commercial and strategic fit.

A little about you:

• 5-8+ years of experience in payment partnerships, business development or commercial roles at a payment service provider, bank, remittance company or fintech, with a track record of sourcing and closing deals with banks and payment providers.

• Demonstrable experience engaging with payment providers and banks across African markets; experience doing the same in Southeast Asia is a strong advantage.

• Deep understanding of cross-border payment flows and the commercial and technical mechanics of PSP and banking partnerships (settlement, FX, licensing, compliance).

• Proven ability to independently source, negotiate and close commercial agreements, from first contact through contract execution and onboarding.

• Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills, able to structure deals that balance cost, risk and speed to market.

• Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a remote-first, distributed team, across multiple time zones and jurisdictions.

• Excellent relationship-management and stakeholder-management skills, able to work cross-functionally with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Product and Engineering.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages relevant to target African (or Southeast Asian) markets are advantageous.

• An existing network of relationships with payment providers and banks in target African markets is a strong advantage.

• Willingness to travel as required to meet partners and represent GTXN in-market.

• Working knowledge of, and genuine interest in, crypto and digital assets is advantageous, given GTXN's role within the broader Luno business.

First 6 Months:

• Build a prioritised pipeline of target payment-provider and banking partners across GTXN’s core African markets.

• Develop a strong working knowledge of GTXN’s existing partner network, product and commercial model.

• Close and onboard the first new partner agreement(s) in a priority market.

• Establish effective working relationships with Compliance, Legal, Risk and Product/Engineering to streamline partner onboarding.

• Build credibility as a trusted point of contact for both new and existing partners.

Act as a central point of contact for all first-line defense risk management and control activities, coordinating between internal departments (product, risk, compliance, finance, legal) and centralized teams to ensure effective risk mitigation strategies.

Maintain Company's Risk & Control Self Assessment (RCSA) on an ongoing basis with a focus on critical processes and with designing, validating and testing of local controls as well as the associated reporting

Maintain consistent, timely monitoring of Key Risk Indicators and promptly report KRI anomalies, or deviations to the Second Line Risk Management function

Support periodic reviews of material outsourcing and relevant third-party/ICT arrangements, including required governance documentation and reporting.

Support local product-governance reviews for new product launches, material changes and periodic reviews.

Timely identification and reporting of local incidents and issues, tracking remediation, control enhancements and audit actions, whilst promoting cross-team collaboration and risk awareness through training and communication

Automation and data analytics to improve risk identification, monitoring, and reporting, leveraging automation where appropriate.

Work on any other projects and matters as raised by the local management

Strong ability to manage complex processes and ensure compliance and operational efficiency across cross-functional teams.

Collaborative mindset with the ability to work closely with multiple internal teams (risk, product, legal, vendor management) to ensure alignment and successful process execution.

Exceptional organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, drive improvements, and escalate issues as needed.

Play a key role in upholding governance and compliance within a rapidly growing and evolving industry.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

At Coinbase, our mission is to increase economic freedom around the world, and we couldn’t do this without hiring the best people. We’re a group of hard-working overachievers who are deeply focused on building the future of finance and Web3 for our users across the globe, whether they’re trading, storing, staking or using crypto. Know those people who always lead the group project? That’s us.

There are a few things we look for across all hires we make at Coinbase, regardless of role or team. First, we look for candidates who will thrive in a culture like ours, where we default to trust, embrace feedback, and disrupt ourselves. Second, we expect all employees to commit to our mission-focused approach to our work. Finally, we seek people who are excited to learn about and live crypto, because those are the folks who enjoy the intense moments in our sprint and recharge work culture. We’re a remote-first company looking to hire the absolute best talent all over the world.

Ready to #LiveCrypto? Who you are:

• You’ve got positive energy. You’re optimistic about the future and determined to get there.

• You’re never tired of learning. You want to be a pro in bleeding edge tech like DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, and Web 3.0.

• You appreciate direct communication. You’re both an active communicator and an eager listener - because let’s face it, you can’t have one without the other. You’re cool with candid feedback and see every setback as an opportunity to grow.

• You can pivot on the fly. Crypto is constantly evolving, so our priorities do, too. What you worked on last month may not be what you work on today, and that excites you. You’re not looking for a boring job.

• You have a “can do” attitude. Our teams create high-quality work on quick timelines. Owning a problem doesn’t scare you, but rather empowers you to take 100% responsibility for achieving our mission.

• You want to be part of a winning team. We’re stronger together, and you’re a person who embraces being pushed out of your comfort zone.

As a Customer Success Associate you will serve as a primary subject matter expert for Coinbase’s products, providing world-class service and support to our most valued customers. You’ll join a team of customer focused support professionals who know their performance is essential to Coinbase achieving its mission. We’re looking for an individual who has a passion for making the customer experience seamless and phenomenal.

What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties):

• Promote customer retention, growth and satisfaction by maintaining positive and long-term customer relationships, including proactively reaching out to customers based on user data, following-up on communications or providing additional education for our highest value customers.

• You will be responsible for providing best in class customer support, handling customers proactively to mitigate issues, handling contacts through to resolution, and collaborating across teams of subject matter specialists to fix issues with urgency.

• Model an investigative mentality: utilize data and customer feedback to help address critical customer issues at the root cause and eliminate defects in the customer experience.

• Proactively identify customer needs before they become an issue to simplify the customer experience, reduce friction, and strengthen trust in Coinbase.

• Champion clear communication with internal and external partners to align on solutions and drive results.

• Develop a deep understanding of Coinbase products and ongoing changes in the macro crypto environment so you can guide customers to navigate the quickly moving and ever changing crypto world and unlock additional features, services, and products that benefit their unique profile.

What we look for in you (ie. job requirements):

• Willingness to work nights and weekends to support the 24/7 nature of cryptocurrency markets.

• Motivated by Coinbase’s mission and creating a seamless experience for our highest value customers.

• Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in a customer service or support role in a fast paced environment including working with high value customers.

• Basic knowledge of blockchain, web3, staking, ROI/staking rewards, self-custody, and/or crypto.

• Flexible and adaptable to meet the evolving needs of a high-growth and fast paced organization.

• Fantastic communication and relationship management skills, passion for assisting customers to use Coinbase products successfully, and an eagerness to create a community of high value Coinbase power users.

Nice to haves:

• High level of proficiency in cryptocurrency and Coinbase products

• Previous experience in tech, crypto, finance, or fintech.

Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Threat Research & Readiness: Conduct targeted research into emerging threat actor TTPs, zero-days, and cloud vulnerabilities to preemptively fortify detection capabilities and response playbooks.

SOAR & Automation: Build and refine automated response playbooks using Python, API integrations, and SOAR tools to streamline repetitive analyst workflows.

8+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in SOC operations, threat detection, and security incident response.

2+ years of direct people management or formal team leadership experience, preferably overseeing a geographically distributed workforce.
•
Deep operational expertise in investigating cloud-native threats (AWS, GCP, or Azure), container environments (Kubernetes, Docker), and modern SaaS infrastructure.

Advanced proficiency with modern SIEM platforms, EDR/XDR suites, log aggregators, and SOAR tools.

Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go to automate triage tasks and query APIs.

Strong knowledge of network protocols, cloud architecture, identity systems (Okta, Azure AD), and digital forensics fundamentals.
•
Proven ability to stay calm, decisive, and communicative under pressure during high-severity security incidents.

Prior experience in Financial Services, FinTech, Digital Assets, or high-throughput trading environments operating under strict regulatory audit standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001, SEC/FINRA frameworks).

Relevant industry certifications such as GIAC (GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, GCDA), CISSP, or OSCP.

• Own end-to-end resolution of customer inquiries across phone, messaging, and email channels by investigating, troubleshooting, and solving issues on first contact.

• Drive accurate issue tracking and defect logging to surface systemic problems and inform upstream product and process improvements.

• Educate customers proactively on Coinbase products and features, setting clear expectations and adding value in every interaction.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to escalate, resolve, and close out complex cases that require coordination beyond frontline support.

• Lead by example within the Customer Support organization by consistently meeting or exceeding performance benchmarks and quality standards.

• 2+ years of experience in customer support within financial services, crypto, fintech, or a technology platform, including multi-channel support (phone, messaging, and email).

• Demonstrated ability to investigate and resolve complex customer issues independently, with a track record of high first-contact resolution rates.

• Proficiency in support tooling such as Salesforce Service Cloud, JIRA, Amazon Connect, or similar CRM and ticketing platforms.

• Fluency in written and spoken English with the ability to communicate clearly across global teams and diverse customer populations.

• Willingness to work rotating shifts, weekends, and holidays from the Manila, Philippines office.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

As a Customer Support Specialst II you will serve as a primary subject matter expert for Coinbase’s products, providing world-class service and support to our most valued customers. You’ll join a team of customer focused support professionals who know their performance is essential to Coinbase achieving its mission. We’re looking for an individual who has a passion for making the customer experience seamless and phenomenal.

What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties):

• Responsible for providing support for high-profile Coinbase customers across multiple channels (phone, messaging & email) by investigating, troubleshooting and resolving customer issues.

• Use all available resources to ensure high standards are met and work is carried out in the most efficient manner.

• Be a trusted advisor, listen and empathize so the customer knows they are valued. Ensure their voices are heard through accurate issue tracking and upstream solutions.

• Take ownership and use critical thinking to find the root cause and solve the customer issue on the first contact. Where this is not possible, ensure all defects are logged appropriately.

• Seek opportunities to add value for customers through education, proactivity and clear expectation setting.

• You will be responsible for providing best in class customer support, handling customers proactively to mitigate issues, handling contacts through to resolution, and collaborating across teams of subject matter specialists to fix issues with urgency.

• Model an investigative mentality: utilize data and customer feedback to help address critical customer issues at the root cause and eliminate defects in the customer experience.

• Proactively identify customer needs before they become an issue to simplify the customer experience, reduce friction, and strengthen trust in Coinbase.

• Champion clear communication with internal and external partners to align on solutions and drive results.

• Develop a deep understanding of Coinbase products and ongoing changes in the macro crypto environment so you can guide customers to navigate the quickly moving and ever changing crypto world and unlock additional features, services, and products that benefit their unique profile.

What we look for in you (ie. job requirements):

• This role requires full-time, in-office presence, five days a week.

• Willingness to work nights and weekends to support the 24/7 nature of cryptocurrency markets.

• Motivated by Coinbase’s mission and creating a seamless experience for our highest value customers.

• Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in a customer service or support role in a fast paced environment including working with high value customers.

• Basic knowledge of blockchain, web3, staking, ROI/staking rewards, self-custody, and/or crypto.

• Flexible and adaptable to meet the evolving needs of a high-growth and fast paced organization.

• Fantastic communication and relationship management skills, passion for assisting customers to use Coinbase products successfully, and an eagerness to create a community of high value Coinbase power users.

Nice to haves:

• Experience at crypto exchanges or in financial services, ideally in payments, trading operations or technical support.

• High level of proficiency in cryptocurrency and Coinbase products

• Experience in training and/or quality auditor roles

• Experience in Banking, Wealth Management, Corporate Finance, Asset Management or FinTech

• Understanding of Google apps, JIRA, Salesforce Service Cloud, or Amazon Connect.

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

 - Review and disposition surveillance alerts across our regulated markets, and record the reasoning behind each decision clearly enough that someone else can follow it.

 - Carry out analytical reviews that begin with trade and order data rather than with a system-generated alert.

 - Investigate escalated behaviour end to end: gather the data, reconstruct what happened, and write it up for presentation to senior compliance stakeholders.

 - Assess referrals raised from across the business and externally, and take forward the ones that warrant it.

 - Draft suspicious transaction and order reports and suspicious activity reports.

 - Produce management information and regulatory reporting for the entities we cover.

 - Contribute to surveillance platform and tooling work, including bringing new products and data sources into scope and testing that detection behaves as intended.

 - Use AI and automation tools to speed up evidence-gathering and case reconstruction, with human judgement over the final call. 

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - At least 2 years experience in trade surveillance, market abuse investigation or trading conduct inside a regulated firm, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, bank or comparable regulated trading business.

 - Working knowledge of the core market abuse typologies, for example spoofing, layering, wash trading, insider dealing, front running and ramping.

 - Experience reviewing and dispositioning surveillance alerts, and writing up what you found to a standard others can rely on.

 - Clear, evidence-first written communication. Your case files and escalations will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them.

 - Comfort using generative AI and other automation tools to improve the speed and quality of investigative work, while maintaining the oversight that regulated casework requires.

 - Hands-on use of a surveillance platform such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus or NICE Actimize.

 - SQL or a similar query tool for evidence-gathering.

 - Experience drafting suspicious transaction and order reports or suspicious activity reports.

 - Electronic communications surveillance experience.

You’ll help engineers and leaders navigate complex technical trade-offs and align around a clear direction, while identifying scaling, cost and resilience risks before they become issues.
• Stay hands-on with our toughest engineering challenges: Work directly on the most critical parts of our platform, writing production code and infrastructure as code and prototyping new approaches. You’ll take the lead on complex challenges across low-latency connectivity, high-throughput streaming, large data and identity migrations and platform reliability.
• Lead and shape AI-native engineering: Help design the core of Pepperstone’s AI platform, from model access and agent orchestration to tool connections, retrieval, evaluation and runtime governance. You’ll use AI coding and agent tools in your day-to-day work while helping establish the patterns, workflows and guardrails that enable our engineers to do the same.

You’ll help ensure security, resilience, data protection and regulatory requirements are considered from the outset.

• You bring extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and platforms with proven Staff or Principal-level impact within a scaled technology, SaaS or fintech environment.

• You bring deep expertise across two or three areas such as AI platforms, cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, global networking, identity and authorisation or data and streaming platforms, with the ability to work credibly across the broader platform landscape.
• You have practical production experience with AI platforms, including LLM APIs, agent orchestration, retrieval, evaluation and AI observability, alongside AI-assisted engineering in your own day-to-day work.
• You understand how to build platforms as products, creating paved roads and developer experiences that are adopted and valued across multiple teams.
• You have experience running always-on, highly available systems and bring strong instincts around reliability, observability, performance and cost.
• You’ve successfully influenced technical direction across multiple teams without relying on direct authority, building trust through strong communication, technical judgement and collaboration.
• You’ve led significant migrations across live platforms and understand how to deliver change without disrupting the teams and clients that rely on them.
• You communicate complex technical decisions clearly to engineers, executives and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy mentoring senior and staff engineers.
• Experience with low-latency trading, market data, payments infrastructure, high-throughput streaming or identity and security at scale would be valuable but isn’t essential.

• Competitive salary structure including company bonus scheme
• Genuinely collaborative and friendly culture
• Flexible and hybrid working

• A full stocked kitchen, onsite coffee machines with locally sourced coffee beans (this is Melbourne after all) and curated specialty teas

•

Managing and executing company-wide compliance programs covering CASL, CRTC UTRs, AML/FINTRAC requirements, and website digital compliance across all web and mobile platforms

•

Leading initiatives to automate AML/FINTRAC identity verification, KYC checks, and transaction monitoring, working cross-functionally with Operations, Product, Technology, and Engineering teams

•

Conducting systematic audits of customer-facing website user journeys, lead-capture forms, disclaimers, terms of service, and automated marketing flows

•

Establishing and managing Existing Business Relationship (EBR) verification and National Do Not Call List (DNCL) access controls within CRM and marketing systems

•

Maintaining, reviewing, and updating compliance policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and tiered disciplinary frameworks, and escalating material non-compliance or red-flag risks to executive leadership

•

Assisting with the triage, investigation, and resolution of consumer and regulatory complaints (CRTC, RECO, RECA, BCFSA, FSRA, Privacy), maintaining audit-ready records

•

Managing reporting inputs for senior management, affiliate Compliance Committees, and regulatory authorities

•

Monitoring legal and regulatory changes to assess operational impacts and recommend necessary adjustments

•

Reviewing consumer data storage protocols and third-party API data sharing, such as lead routing to partner brokerages, to guarantee legal consent compliance

•

Auditing and maintaining Zolo's public-facing Privacy Policy and Terms of Use

•

Managing and maintaining the master register of all regulated entities, provincial brokerage licences, and statutory roles, including Brokers of Record, Managing Brokers, Alternate/Secondary Brokers of Record, Branch Managers, and Principal Mortgage Brokers across Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and other operating jurisdictions

•

Monitoring and coordinating annual licensing renewal cycles, corporate regulatory filings, RECO/BCFSA/RECA/FSRA portal roster updates (such as RECO MyWeb, BCFSA IRIS, and myRECA), fee processing, and mandatory continuing education (CE) compliance for all designated brokerage leaders and corporate entities

Investigating cases and performing initial case analysis to support senior compliance staff

•

Finding and implementing efficiencies using AI and other technology

•

Adhering to Questrade's and Zolo's compliance policies and procedures

Inspired by Bitcoin's vision of financial freedom, we are committed to empowering individuals to transact and connect seamlessly across the globe. From the early days of the Bitcoin revolution, our mission has been to champion freedom through innovative, reliable, and accessible technology—ensuring that everyone, everywhere, has the tools to participate in a truly open and borderless world.

We are driven by a relentless pursuit of innovation and financial empowerment. By prioritizing education and delivering a cutting-edge platform, we enable users to seamlessly buy, hold, and trade digital assets with confidence. As the digital asset landscape rapidly evolves, we stay ahead—offering state-of-the-art trading services that empower both individuals and global liquidity providers. Our forward-thinking, agile approach ensures that financial freedom is not just a vision, but a reality for all.

Our team, composed of visionary individuals with practical expertise, focuses on crafting solutions to the market's toughest challenges. Despite our global presence and impact, we maintain a small, technology-focused core, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation.

We value integrity and autonomy, empowering our team to contribute from concept to launch. Driven by a passion for lifelong learning and a commitment to advancing freedom, we prioritize high-caliber products and services, with a proven track record of innovation that draws on the dexterity of our teams.

Why Join Us?
Innovation
At Bitfinex, we merge technology and skill to create an environment where your involvement isn’t just appreciated—it’s pioneering the future and pushing boundaries in finance. Our culture values bold creativity, a passion for technology, and a deep belief in Financial Freedom.

Flexibility & Global Reach
We believe in trust, autonomy, and results—our team operates remotely, ensuring you work from anywhere while collaborating with some of the best talents across the world. We thrive on innovation, autonomy, and breaking new ground.

Fast-Paced & Impactful
Much like the crypto industry itself, our projects move fast, break new ground, and make an impact. Your contributions reach our global audience, shaping the narrative of a decentralized future.

A Team that Thrives on Collaboration
We blend seasoned experts with fresh creative minds, ensuring constant innovation, mentorship, and a dynamic work environment that keeps you at the forefront of achieving your goals. We see integrity and standing up for what is right as the most important qualities.

Grow with the Best
At Bitfinex, we’re committed to continuous learning—whether through technological advancements, creative workshops, or mentorship from leading professionals in the industry.

If you’re excited about partaking in shaping the narrative of decentralized finance, you’ll feel right at home!

The Role:
The primary purpose of this position is to efficiently and effectively conduct and adjudicate (i.e. investigate) referrals of unusual activity made to the Compliance Team with a view to timely (within regulatory timelines) SAR submission within applicable jurisdictions or closing the referral as not suspicious, supported by articulated, reasoned argument.

The incumbent is a member of the AML Investigations Team reporting directly to the Head of Investigation Team, with a dotted line to the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO). The incumbent will also work closely with other Compliance and Customer Support teams, and peer AML Investigators in addressing both fraud and money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions risks.

The incumbent will maintain and develop strong relationships and network amongst peers in the industry to learn and share best practices and investigative techniques.

In performing the role, the incumbent will continuously strive to continuously self-develop and enhance their skill sets incl. understanding blockchain technology, virtual currencies, suspicious activities in the space, criminals’ modus operandi and best investigative practices to mitigate against the risk of money laundering, financing terrorism or violating sanctions on behalf of Bitfinex and to ensure the company’s robust Regulatory Compliance requirements.

•
Conducting investigations assigned by the Head of Investigation Team to determine risk exposure to Bitfinex and mitigating risks by SAR filing, recommendations for account closure, freezing of funds as applicable.
•
Providing support to Customer Help Desk / Legal Team requests for investigative assistance.
•
Communication with customers, agents, and internal attorneys as applicable.

What You Bring to the Table:
In addition to the skill set preferred requirements listed below, the incumbent must be able to work independently with minimum supervision (seeking guidance as required), flexible as to working arrangement and hours and confident in making decisions as delegated by Head of Investigation Team / CCO.

Knowledge:
•
University education (Preferred)
•
Experience in an investigative function
•
Experience using blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis, etc. TRM, Elliptic,
•
Demonstrated AML experience incl. customer and enhanced due diligence (CDD/EDD), AML/CTF/Sanctions Investigations, SAR/STR reporting
•
Basic knowledge of blockchain technology (enhanced in the role)
•
CAMS/CBP designation (Preferred)

Skills:
•
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
•
Demonstrated critical thinking skills (decision-making)
•
Demonstrated attention to detail
•
Organisational understanding (enhanced in the role)

What We Offer:
•
Flexible Work & Remote-Friendly Culture
•
Mentorship & Growth
•
Competitive Pay
•
Career Development Opportunities
•
Supportive Team Environment
•
Learning & Knowledge Sharing
•
Team-Building Activities
•
Social activities (online & in-person)

Ready to join us in bringing Financial Freedom to all?

If you’re a visionary who thrives at the intersection of technology, knowledge and innovation, we want to hear from you!

Recruitment Data & Security Disclaimer
As part of the hiring process at Bitfinex, we collect personal data such as your name, contact details, location, job preferences, education and employment history, and other information you voluntarily provide. This data is used solely for recruitment purposes, processed in accordance with applicable global data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and retained only for as long as necessary to fulfil its purpose.

All assessments and recruitment-related communications are conducted exclusively through official Bitfinex email addresses (e.g., firstname.lastname@bitfinex.com). Bitfinex does not use unofficial channels (such as WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS) for recruitment communication and does not distribute assessments or sensitive links via those means.

As part of our secure and compliant recruitment process, we may use approved third-party platforms to facilitate candidate assessments. For more information, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice and Interview Recording Consent. All candidates have the right to access, correct, or delete their personal data and to withdraw consent at any time, where applicable.

Bitfinex will never request payments, financial information, or personal banking details at any stage of the recruitment process.
If you receive a suspicious request, wish to exercise your data privacy rights, or have further inquiries regarding the legal aspects of the process, contact privacy@bitfinex.com. Please note this inbox is intended for privacy concerns and reports only; any other communications will not be processed.

Equal Opportunity Statement
At Bitfinex, we're committed to equitable opportunities. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. This commitment applies across all stages of recruitment and contractual relationships.

The Role:
The primary purpose of this position is to efficiently and effectively conduct and adjudicate (i.e. investigate) referrals of unusual activity made to the Compliance Team with a view to timely (within regulatory timelines) SAR submission within applicable jurisdictions or closing the referral as not suspicious, supported by articulated, reasoned argument.

The incumbent is a member of the AML Investigations Team reporting directly to the Head of Investigation Team, with a dotted line to the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO). The incumbent will also work closely with other Compliance and Customer Support teams, and peer AML Investigators in addressing both fraud and money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions risks.

The incumbent will maintain and develop strong relationships and network amongst peers in the industry to learn and share best practices and investigative techniques.

In performing the role, the incumbent will continuously strive to continuously self-develop and enhance their skill sets incl. understanding blockchain technology, virtual currencies, suspicious activities in the space, criminals’ modus operandi and best investigative practices to mitigate against the risk of money laundering, financing terrorism or violating sanctions on behalf of Bitfinex and to ensure the company’s robust Regulatory Compliance requirements.

•
Conducting investigations assigned by the Head of Investigation Team to determine risk exposure to Bitfinex and mitigating risks by SAR filing, recommendations for account closure, freezing of funds as applicable.
•
Providing support to Customer Help Desk / Legal Team requests for investigative assistance.
•
Communication with customers, agents, and internal attorneys as applicable.

What You Bring to the Table:
In addition to the skill set preferred requirements listed below, the incumbent must be able to work independently with minimum supervision (seeking guidance as required), flexible as to working arrangement and hours and confident in making decisions as delegated by Head of Investigation Team / CCO.

Knowledge:
•
University education (Preferred)
•
Experience in an investigative function
•
Experience using blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis, etc. TRM, Elliptic,
•
Demonstrated AML experience incl. customer and enhanced due diligence (CDD/EDD), AML/CTF/Sanctions Investigations, SAR/STR reporting
•
Basic knowledge of blockchain technology (enhanced in the role)
•
CAMS/CBP designation (Preferred)

Skills:
•
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
•
Demonstrated critical thinking skills (decision-making)
•
Demonstrated attention to detail
•
Organisational understanding (enhanced in the role)

Our Hiring Philosophy:

At etoro, AI is changing how we build, work and make decisions, and our hiring approach reflects that. We are building an AI-first organisation where people are encouraged to use AI thoughtfully.

That starts with how we hire. Throughout our recruitment process, we may use AI-enabled tools, including interview notetakers and other technologies that help us capture information accurately, improve consistency and create a better experience for candidates and interviewers. These tools support our feedback and assessment outcomes. Hiring decisions remain grounded in running fair and consistent interview processes, human judgement, critical thinking, and thorough evaluation of experience, ability and motivation that are aligned to our business and role requirements.

We also want candidates to be comfortable working with AI. Depending on the role, we may explore how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, how you think about their opportunities and limitations, and how you would contribute to etoro’s continued AI build-out.

For us, being AI-first is not about replacing human judgement. It is about combining human expertise, creativity and accountability with technology that helps us do our best work and accelerate our growth. In the end, that's what we're hiring for: human insight, supercharged by AI.

Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out.

You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. You will work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Finance Operations, Group Tax, Legal, Data Privacy, and the local entity leads.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries.

•

Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline.

•

Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Nothing files without your release.

•

Manage the tax platform vendor: contract scope, delivery calendar, test cycles, output validation, issue resolution, and the annual renewal decision.

•

Set the group reporting policy and interpret the regimes for OKX: reportable crypto-assets, transfers to unhosted wallets, staking and reward income, retail payment thresholds, residency tie-breakers, and TIN rules, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and external tax advisers.

•

Own the global tax self-certification design in onboarding, including validation rules, refresh triggers, and the backlog remediation program for existing users, working with Compliance and Product.

•

Define the process for restricting undocumented accounts under DAC8 and CARF, including reason codes and customer communications, with restrictions applied automatically in Product and monitored by the central team.

•

Maintain the entity-by-entity readiness tracker covering domestic enactment, registration, self-certification coverage, and deadlines. Report weekly to the CCO and monthly to the CARF steering committee.

•

Hands-on leader. Build a small, senior team, scaled through the reporting vendor and outside advisers. Coordinate with and train local compliance and entity leads.

•

Support independent testing by Compliance Monitoring, Risk, and Internal Audit, and support tax authority examinations with complete, reproducible records.

What We Look For In You

•

7+ years in tax information reporting, tax operations, or regulatory data reporting at a global exchange, broker, bank, fintech, or digital asset platform, including at least 3 years leading a team.

•

Hands-on experience in a global, distributed digital asset business: you have worked with exchange or wallet transaction data, multiple legal entities, and users spread across many jurisdictions. This is required.

•

Strong data skills. You can write SQL, define data specifications for engineers, reconcile large transaction datasets to a ledger, and find the gap when the numbers do not tie. You have built or run data quality controls on reporting output.

•

Working knowledge of CARF, DAC8, CRS, and FATCA, including due diligence rules, self-certification requirements, reportable transaction categories, and the XML schemas used for exchange. Direct CARF or DAC8 implementation experience is strongly preferred given live DAC8 obligations and upcoming CARF reporting.

Experience managing a tax reporting vendor or reporting platform, including scoping, testing, and holding the vendor to a delivery calendar. the tax platform vendor experience is a plus.

Experience building a function from a small base: writing the policy, designing the controls, hiring the team, and running the first cycle.

Ability to explain data and tax issues plainly to executives, engineers, and local compliance officers, and to run a steering committee.

•

Judgment on when to escalate, comfort working across US, EU, and Asia time zones, and a record of meeting hard filing deadlines.

Nice to Haves

•

Experience with US Form 1099-DA or 1099-B production, backup withholding, or Qualified Intermediary reporting.

•

Experience with the DAC8 60-day account restriction process or equivalent undocumented account remediation at scale.

Our team has unique expertise in research, analysis, and product development. By relying on technical insights and a data-driven approach, we create disruptive future-defining innovations of the fin-tech industry that remain our basis for success

Responsibilities

• Develop and optimize the business logic for A-Book/B-Book routing, Net Exposure limits, and flow internalization algorithms to maximize B-Book yield

• Design, backtest, and implement new rules in the Detection Engine to identify toxic trading, arbitrage, and fraudulent activity

• Design the complete lifecycle of risk signals: Detection, Observation, Validation, Confirmation, Action, Monitoring

• Investigate the relationships between client behavior, execution quality (slippage, latency, fill rate), liquidity costs, and the broker’s overall P&L

• Systematically monitor the performance of deployed rules, analyze false positives and false negatives, mitigate model drift, and adjust thresholds

• Lead a team of analysts, prioritize the research backlog, and mentor team members

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience at FX/CFD brokers, cryptocurrency exchanges (CEX/DEX), HFT firms, market-making firms, prime brokerages, or proprietary trading firms in roles such as Risk Product Manager, Senior Trading Risk Analyst, Quantitative Risk Lead, or Surveillance Strategy Lead

• In-depth understanding of brokerage models (A-Book, B-Book, C-Book, STP, and internalization) and their direct impact on company P&L

• Strong knowledge of pricing principles, order books (L2/L3), adverse selection, markouts (1s, 5s, 1m), spreads, slippage, execution latency, and fill quality

• Hands-on experience detecting and mitigating latency arbitrage, scalping, exploitation of news-driven price spikes, toxic flow, wash trading, spoofing, layering, and DEX/MEV attacks

• Understanding of statistics, probability distributions, time series, mathematical expectation (expectancy), drawdown, volatility, and Sharpe/Sortino ratios

• Practical experience with routers, bridges, and monitoring systems, CEX matching engines, risk management systems (RMS)

• Intermediate (B1) or higher

• Ability to combine in-depth mathematical analysis of market data with a product-oriented approach, translating ideas into technical specifications with clear acceptance criteria

Will be a plus

• Hands-on trading experience or experience developing algorithmic trading strategies, including HFT and market-making strategies

• Experience building a trading fraud or toxic flow detection system from scratch, from initial hypothesis through production deployment

• Knowledge of mathematical modeling methods, Monte Carlo simulations, Value at Risk (VaR), stress testing, and market panic scenarios

• Practical experience with MetaTrader 4/5 Server/Manager APIs or CEX APIs/WebSockets

• Understanding of the specific characteristics of the cryptocurrency trading industry

• Proficiency in SQL and Python (Pandas, NumPy, Stats, SciPy) to independently process large volumes of tick-level data and test hypotheses

We offer

• 20 paid vacation days per year

• 10 paid sick leave days per year

• Public holidays as per the company’s approved Public holiday list

• Medical insurance

• Opportunity to work remotely

• Professional education budget

• Language learning budget

• Wellness budget (gym membership, sports gear and related expenses)

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Consumer team owns the Kraken app experience used by millions of traders and crypto newcomers worldwide, the product that turns someone's first crypto curiosity into a long-term relationship with Kraken. We build the interfaces people actually use to buy, sell, manage their portfolio, and interact with their assets. Our stack is React on web and React Native on mobile, and we ship fast, measure everything, and iterate based on real user behaviour. We work agile, globally distributed, and we care as much about why we build something as how we build it.

We're looking for a world-class Senior Frontend Engineer to join our product-minded engineering team: we care about customer problems, measurable outcomes, frontend craft, and fast iteration. We work across web and mobile surfaces, partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Platform teams, and use experimentation, observability, and user behaviour to guide what we build next.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Design, develop, and maintain high-quality consumer-facing features across web (React) and mobile (React Native), owning the full experience from concept to production monitoring.

 - Own the full lifecycle of product work, from discovery and technical design through release, monitoring, experimentation, and iteration.

 - Drive A/B testing and experimentation strategies forming hypotheses, designing experiments, analysing results, and iterating based on data.

 - Partner with Product, Design, Data, and Mobile engineers to create coherent experiences across Kraken’s consumer surfaces.

 - Make opinionated technical decisions on framework and architecture choices (we want engineers who have strong views on things like TanStack Router vs Next.js App Router and can back them up with real experience).

 - Set the standard for high-quality code — functional correctness, accessibility, performance, and testability are non-negotiables.

 - Mentor engineers across seniority levels and contribute to a culture of craft and continuous improvement.

 - Lead and collaborate on complex cross-platform initiatives, driving alignment across web and mobile surfaces.

 - Stay ahead of the curve on React ecosystem tooling, React Server Components, concurrent features, streaming, and bring those insights back to the team.

 - Work AI-natively, we use AI tools across the full SDLC and expect engineers to have a structured, opinionated workflow, not just autocomplete.

 
 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 6+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on consumer-facing web and/or mobile products.

 - Deep expertise in TypeScript and the React ecosystem, you have opinions about state management, data fetching patterns, and component architecture, and you can articulate the trade-offs.

 - Production experience with React Native and cross-platform mobile development, including App Store and Google Play release pipelines.

 - Experience with Next.js — specifically familiarity with App Router, React Server Components, and the client/server boundary decisions that come with them.

 - Hands-on experience with A/B testing, feature flags, and experimentation frameworks (LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, or similar).

 - Experience with WebSockets or Server-Sent Events for real-time UI updates.

 - Strong testing culture Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress, and the judgement to know when to use each.

 - Familiarity with modern build tooling (Vite, Webpack, CI/CD pipelines) and performance profiling.

 - Experience in fintech, crypto, payments, or other high-trust consumer products where correctness and user confidence matter.

 - Strong written and verbal English, you can write a clear RFC, give direct feedback in a PR review, and explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder.

 - An active AI-assisted development workflow, Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or equivalent with the engineering rigour to review and own what gets produced.

 - Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including LLM and AI-enabled tools, to enhance alert triage, investigations, SAR filing and FIU operational capabilities

 - Collaborate with Compliance leadership, including RCOs and MLROs, to maintain well-governed transaction monitoring frameworks aligned with regulatory expectations

 - Support FIU scalability by designing processes and monitoring strategies that enable expansion into new products, regions, and increased transaction volumes

 
 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in AML, financial crime compliance, or FIU operations, with deep knowledge of transaction monitoring frameworks, suspicious activity detection, and regulatory expectations under BSA/AML regimes

 - 3+ years of experience designing, testing, and tuning transaction monitoring rules, including threshold optimization, scenario design, and alert reduction strategies

 - 3+ years of experience working with transaction monitoring systems and compliance tooling, including case management platforms, monitoring infrastructure, and investigative workflows

 - Experience working in a regulated financial institution, preferably one licensed to operate in the EU, UK, and/or United States

 - Experience driving process optimization or automation initiatives within compliance or financial crime programs to improve operational efficiency and scalability

 - Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data, or Operations teams to implement monitoring controls, vendor integrations, or compliance technology solutions

 - Strong analytical and data interpretation skills, with experience using metrics, dashboards, and data analysis to evaluate monitoring effectiveness and improve detection quality

 - Experience operating in fast-growing fintech, payments, or crypto environments, with the ability to design scalable compliance controls that support new product launches and geographic expansion

 - Experience working with AI, machine learning, or LLM-enabled compliance tools, including investigative automation or alert triage technologies

 - Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic, or similar crypto investigative platforms

 - Experience supporting vendor selection, implementation, or integration of regtech solutions

 - ACAMS, CAMS-Audit, CFCS, or similar financial crime certifications

It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.



Payward’s Payments & Blockchain team builds the capabilities that move money into and out of its products, connecting banking partners, payment providers and local rails for millions of users.


We’re building a peer-to-peer marketplace for Asia-Pacific that lets users buy and sell digital assets directly with each other using familiar local payment methods. Payward will provide the marketplace infrastructure, merchant network, escrow, transaction management, and trust and safety capabilities.


We’re looking for an experienced product leader who has launched crypto P2P in APAC and can turn that expertise into a shared platform serving multiple Payward products.




THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Strategy and market expansion: Set the P2P vision, business objectives and roadmap. Prioritize markets, customer segments and payment methods based on demand, competitive conditions, economics and regulatory requirements.

 - Merchant network and liquidity: Develop the merchant acquisition, onboarding, incentives and retention strategy. Work with commercial and local teams to build dependable liquidity, competitive pricing and coverage across relevant payment methods.

 - Marketplace economics: Define fee structures and incentive programs. Set commercial targets and improve revenue, transaction costs and contribution margin with finance and commercial partners.

 - Core P2P capabilities: Lead product development across matching, escrow, order management, payment confirmation, transaction limits, merchant controls and dispute handling.

 - Platform adoption: Build reusable capabilities and integration requirements that allow multiple Payward products to offer P2P. Make the platform straightforward to integrate, operate and extend into new markets.

 - Buyer, seller and merchant requirements: Define transaction workflows, exception handling and acceptance criteria. Bring customer research and marketplace expertise into interface decisions, and use transaction data to identify friction and improve completion.

 - Trust and marketplace integrity: Partner with risk, compliance, legal and operations to build merchant verification, fraud prevention, dispute resolution and appeals into the product from the outset.

 - Launch and operating performance: Lead cross-functional launch planning and establish the processes needed to run each market. Track liquidity, order completion, time to trade, repeat usage, dispute rates, fraud losses and platform reliability.

 - Product leadership: Align senior stakeholders around priorities and tradeoffs, work closely with engineering on system capabilities, and develop product talent as the platform scales. Apply proven P2P playbooks and move quickly from decisions to live transactions.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - A demonstrated record of launching and scaling a crypto P2P marketplace in APAC, ideally including a launch from zero.

 - Senior product leadership experience with responsibility for strategy, roadmaps and measurable commercial outcomes.

 - Deep understanding of merchant operations, two-sided liquidity, pricing, incentives and the economics of P2P trading.

 - Practical knowledge of APAC payment methods, local banking and wallet ecosystems, and how customer behavior differs across markets.

 - Experience building shared platform capabilities used by multiple products, channels or external partners.

 - Strong judgment about fraud, payment verification, transaction disputes and the operational realities of running a financial marketplace.

 - Technical fluency across APIs, transaction lifecycles, payment integrations and reliable financial systems.

 - The ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead through partnerships with engineering, interface product teams, operations, risk and commercial teams.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience expanding P2P across several APAC markets.

 - Experience with stablecoins and local fiat on/off-ramps.

 - Experience building and leading product teams.

 - Fluency in one or more APAC languages.

BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE


Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's engineers build a lot of software. Developer Platform AI builds the AI systems they use to do it: agents that write and review code, simple access to the best models in the tools they already use, and the infrastructure that connects AI to our internal systems.

This is a small team with a lot of reach. The tools you ship will change how engineers across Kraken work every day, and you'll see that happen directly. The work spans agent platforms, code review, LLM routing and cost controls, MCP integrations with tools like Slack, Jira and GitLab, and the security and observability that make all of it safe to run.

If you want to work on applied AI with real users from day one, this is that job.

 





THE OPPORTUNITY

 - LLM traffic doesn't behave like normal API traffic. Requests are long-running, streaming and expensive. One prompt can cost a few cents or a few dollars. One team's burst can burn another team's budget. Providers change their rate limits, failure modes and pricing without warning. Running this well is a problem few companies have solved, and it's the job.
   
   - Own the reliability of the platform engineers depend on: the AI Gateway, the agent runtime and the connections to internal tools. Set the SLOs, own the error budgets and decide what happens when they're spent.
   
   - Design resilience across model providers: routing, failover, retries, rate limiting and graceful degradation when a provider is slow, throttling or down.
   
   - Make LLM traffic legible. Build observability that shows latency, errors, token usage and cost by team, model and use case, so engineers can see what their workloads cost and where they're spending their time waiting.
   
   - Treat capacity and cost as one problem. Routing decisions affect both latency and spend, and you'll own the tradeoff directly.
   
   - Work with Security, Finance and AI governance to put access controls, budgets, audit logging and data handling into the platform, not into a spreadsheet next to it.
   
   - Lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews. Turn what breaks into fixes that stay fixed.
   
   - Automate operations with infrastructure as code, safe deployments and progressive rollouts, so the platform gets more reliable as it grows rather than more fragile.
   
   - Mentor engineers and raise the operating standard across the team.
   
   This is a Staff role. You'll set the technical direction for how the platform runs, not just keep it running. The platform is small enough that your decisions shape it directly, and used broadly enough that they affect every engineering team at Kraken.
   
   


SKILLS YOU SHOULD HODL

 - Extensive experience in site reliability, infrastructure or platform engineering, with a track record of owning high-traffic, business-critical services in production

 - Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes, a major cloud provider and infrastructure as code such as Terraform

 - Strong command of SLOs, observability and incident management, and the judgment to know which reliability work actually matters

 - Proficiency in Rust or Python, and comfort reading and changing a production service's code

 - Experience with API gateways, reverse proxies or traffic management: load balancing, rate limiting, failover and caching

 - Experience operating multi-tenant internal platforms, including authentication, authorization and per-tenant cost controls

 - Staff-level influence: you set direction across teams, write clear design documents and bring other engineers with you



NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience operating LLM gateways or integrating LLM provider APIs at scale: streaming, token-based rate limiting, model routing and caching

 - Experience serving models yourself, including vLLM or Ray: GPU scheduling, batching, autoscaling and cost per token

 - Experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators with controller-runtime or kubebuilder

 - Experience with Consul and Vault for service discovery, configuration and secrets

 - Experience with model evaluation pipelines for catching quality regressions before and after rollout

 - Familiarity with coding agents and agent harnesses, and running them safely in sandboxed environments

 - Experience with cost attribution, budgeting or FinOps for usage-based services

 - Background in security-sensitive or regulated environments such as financial services or crypto

 - Contributions to open-source gateway, proxy or observability projects



Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.




OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.


We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.


As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

We have always been innovators. In 1996 we were the first company to share exchange rate information, free of charge on the internet. Today, we are a world leading online trading group.

Join us to:
• Help build the future of online trading
• Be part of a culture driven by integrity and global impact
• Become part of an award-winning company - check out our full list of awards here

We are only as good as our people. Luckily, our people are the best. Join us!

How do we work?

Hello Relationship Builders!

As our Relationship Manager, you will be responsible for driving revenue by the onboarding, retaining and reactivation of High-Value Clients (HVC). This will involve not only providing exceptional service to our existing clients but developing and growing a book of top tier clients through referrals and reactivation of dormant accounts. The role requires candidates to build strong relationships with clients as well identifying opportunities to grow new business. A large part of these sales activities will take place over telephone calls and via emails to prospective and existing clients.

You will be based out of Chicago while collaborating closely with our dedicated client-facing team located in Toronto.

We work in a hybrid model-we’d love to meet you in our Chicago / New York office 2–3 days per week with respect to your own commitments.

In this role, you will:

• Develop a pipeline of High-Value Clients from prospective leads and convert existing clients to HVCs status.
• Engage clients with the full suite of OANDA products while educating them about the markets and leveraged trading.
• Grow trading volume and assets under management for high-value clients and potential high-volume clients.
• Proactively engage in outbound client communications and manage inbound communications on product, regulatory and account related updates.
• Identify initiatives to assist in achieving business goals, meet or exceed all assigned key performance indicators (KPIs) as well as add value to the team success.
• Work closely with the new account department to ensure a smooth on-boarding process for new HVCs.

What skillset do you need to be successful in this role?

• Min. 3 years of outbound sales, client retention, or account management experience within financial services, brokerage, or another heavily regulated sector, but impact matters more than years.
• Genuine passion for financial markets and leveraged products (FX, CFDs, Commodities) - you can comfortably discuss macroeconomic news, technical charts, and trading strategies with sophisticated investors.
• Natural ability to build immediate rapport over phone and email, earn trust with high-net-worth clients, and uncover latent account growth opportunities.
• Self-motivated mindset with a history of hitting and exceeding ambitious volume, AUM, and retention targets in a fast-paced environment.
• Verbal and written communication skills; able to break down complex trading products, platform features, and account requirements clearly.
• Active Series 3 and Series 34 licenses, or willingness to obtain them upon joining.

Nice to have:

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce (or a similar enterprise CRM) and modern sales intelligence platforms.
• Prior experience dealing with retail Forex/CFD traders or institutional trading desks.

Experience or strong interest in data analysis, business analysis, automation, AI-enabled tools, or compliance systems.

Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into operational processes.

Well-organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage documentation and controls accurately.

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Proficiency in monitoring compliance databases, risk tools, and reporting systems (e.g., transaction monitoring, screening tools).

A proactive mindset, high integrity, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.
